# Vendored stylesheet: daisyUI

- Package: `daisyui@5.8.2`
- Upstream: <https://github.com/saadeghi/daisyui> (MIT, 42.9k stars at 2026-11)
- File: `daisyui.css`, downloaded 2026-11-22 from `https://unpkg.com/daisyui@5.8.2/daisyui.css`
- SHA-256: `818b8ca8824cf87f43987d844742ac66dadc3a9c07ae2e1f9208afcd9db6d19b`
- Size: 1,182,393 bytes

The file is the standalone full build: themes, components and the color/radius
utility layer, so it works without a Tailwind build step or a CDN. It does not
include Tailwind layout utilities (`flex`, `grid`, `gap-*`, `w-full`, `shadow-*`);
`preview.css` supplies only those layout/spacing/elevation helpers.

Do not edit this file. Theme overrides live in `workbench/preview.css` under
`[data-theme="cuekeeper"]` and only set daisyUI's own theme variables.
